fusions.name: Ox-Weight Ball
fusions.desc: After 2 seconds loading, fires a heavy ball at an enemy up to 9 tiles away that deals 38 damage plus 6% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Running Iron
fusions.desc: Fires a heated round at an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 7 fire damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and leaves it [Marked] for 8 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Unhurried Aim
fusions.desc: After 2 seconds settling, your damage rises by 35% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Wind
fusions.desc: When your stamina fills, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
